request.query: coefficient l1 norm finite product multivariate polynomial

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_prod
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_4} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ]
  (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : Finset ι),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) (∏ j ∈ s, f j) = ∑ l ∈ s.finsuppAntidiag d, ∏ i ∈ s, (MvPowerSeries.coeff (l i)) (f i)

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → R

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n (p * q) = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, MvPolynomial.coeff x.1 p * MvPolynomial.coeff x.2 q

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ ψ : MvPowerSeries σ R) [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ],
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff n) (φ * ψ) =
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1) φ * (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2) ψ

items.name: MonomialOrder.coeff_prod_sum_degree
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} (P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R)
  (s : Finset ι), MvPolynomial.coeff (∑ i ∈ s, m.degree (P i)) (∏ i ∈ s, P i) = ∏ i ∈ s, m.leadingCoeff (P i)

items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_prod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i).leadingCoeff = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).leadingCoeff
